utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time is book club?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe around 7 if that still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I need to know the time and where we’re meeting so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll confirm the time and place before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Just let me know once you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the book club? I might’ve missed the last update—what’s going on with it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—we’re still meeting next Thursday, I think. I’ll double-check the time and let you know so you don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. I’m a bit scattered lately, so please let me know once you’ve confirmed the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for book club, and I’ll be sure to pass the plan along to everyone else too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll see everyone at book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what book did I miss, and did I miss the good part?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You missed the middle of the discussion, but the best part’s still coming up—want me to catch you up quick?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please—give me the quick version. I’m all ears for the good part.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what day and time are we meeting for book club, and which book should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: How about Thursday at 7 PM at my place, and bring *The Thursday Murder Club* if you have it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 at your place works for me—I’ll bring *The Thursday Murder Club*.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at the library on Thursday, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We're still set for the library on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d love to hear what the book club is reading next—maybe I can help get everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at the library on Thursday, and I’ve got the next book picked out already.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect—what book did you pick? If you want, I can help spread the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m glad we’re finally talking book club. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad too, Mara — I was thinking we could go with something lively but still easy to discuss. I can send around a couple of options and we can pick together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect — send me the options and I’ll weigh in. I’m excited to pick something the whole group will enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, book club? I can bring extra tea and cookies if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, thanks — that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll bring the tea and cookies next time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking the next read tonight, so we should probably show up early if we want a say.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that sounds smart. I can come a little early.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll bring the cookies and save us a couple chairs near the front.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the book club details before I say for sure—what book and what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re reading “The Midnight Library,” and we’re meeting this Thursday at 7 pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ve got “The Midnight Library” this Thursday at 7 pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what book are we discussing again?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re discussing "The Night Circus" this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, The Night Circus—got it. I’ll skim it before book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the others about the book club plan and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—thanks, Vik. Keep me posted and I’ll go with whatever the group decides.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do—I’ll talk to the others and get back to you once we’ve settled on a plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? Right — I might’ve missed the update. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s "The Overstory" this month. I can send you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do — I’d appreciate the details. I’ve been a bit out of the loop lately.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club, but I’d be glad to hear how it’s been going.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s been pretty good — a small, friendly group, and we’ve had some good discussions lately. If you want, I can lend you a copy of the next book too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like to give it a try and see how I fit in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Opal—what book are we thinking for the next club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m leaning toward "The Midnight Library"—it’s easy to discuss and the copies are easy to find at the library.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great pick, Opal—easy to get and with plenty to talk about. I’ll note it for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make it if the timing works, but I’ll need the details pretty early so I can plan around everything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the book club time and place as soon as I have it, and I’ll make sure you get it early.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I appreciate that — just send it over as soon as you can so I can make my plans.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely still doing the book club at your place this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but let me double-check the day and time before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good — can you confirm it when you know?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m probably going to join a bit late, but I can still make it. What book are we on this week?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re on the book club pick for this week, and I’ll bring the agenda. Just come when you can, and we’ll get you caught up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new novel soon—did you get the update?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I can check the supply list and see if the flyer’s come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m still catching up on the details. Let me know if the flyer has the title on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I meant to bring my notes, but I forgot them again. What book are we talking about this week?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re on "The River Between" this week — no worries, we can still chat about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s the one — I really liked the river scenes. I’ll try to remember my thoughts better next time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work as long as it doesn’t conflict with school pickup or homework time. What day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wednesday evenings work best for me — I can keep it short and start after pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wednesday evenings could work for me too, as long as we keep it brief and start after pickup. What time were you thinking?
